Wan2.1 I2V takes a single keyframe + prompt and animates a 5-second (81-frame @ 16fps) 480p video.

Hardware:
- 14B model: needs ~16GB VRAM (fp8) or 24GB+ (fp16)
- 1.3B model: needs ~6GB VRAM, faster

If you have a 4060 Ti 16GB, use fp8 + 480p.

Install via: cd custom_nodes && git clone https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper.git

aicss.model_recommended: Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P fp8 (~14GB VRAM, 16GB GPU required) OR Wan2.1-I2V-1.3B-480P (~2.5GB VRAM)
notes: Upload your keyframe to ComfyUI, type its filename in node 2.
Replace node 1 ckpt_name with 1.3B variant if your VRAM is tight.
Steps=30, cfg=4.0, sampler=uni_pc are Wan2.1's recommended settings.
81 frames @ 16fps = 5.06 seconds. Increase num_frames and fps for longer clips (need more VRAM).
